companyEnvironments.captureInProgress.en: Capture is in progress. If this state remains after a refresh or interrupted request, cancel it to return to the active template controls.
companyEnvironments.captureInProgress.zh-CN: 正在捕获。如果刷新或请求中断后仍保持此状态，请取消以返回当前模板控件。

companyEnvironments.imageStale.en: Not in use — the environment configuration changed since this image was captured. Runs fall back to the base configuration until you capture a new image.
companyEnvironments.imageStale.zh-CN: 未使用 - 捕获此镜像后环境配置已更改。在捕获新镜像前，运行会回退到基础配置。
